m.s: Rinse {brownrice} until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with twice its volume of cold water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low for 25 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for 5 minutes.
Mix {soy}, {mirin}, {honey} and finely grated {ginger} to make the teriyaki. Pour half over {chk_breast} and leave for 10 minutes.

Heat a drizzle of oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Pour in the rest of the teriyaki for the last minute and let it bubble into a glaze. Rest, then slice.
Peel {carrot} and {cucumber} into ribbons with a veggie peeler. Toss with {ricevinegar} and a pinch of salt.
Cook {edamame} in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain. Slice {avocado} and {springonion}.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the chicken, edamame, pickled veg and avocado. Finish with the spring onion, {sesameseeds} and a squeeze of {lime}.

l: Made for lunch. Pack the avocado whole and slice it on the day. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Tamari instead of soy in the teriyaki, cooked in a separate pan. Check the mirin.
